title: CES Result Message
description: Signal from CES about a submission. Results are already written to DB by CES (D-81); api uses these messages to push WebSocket frames to the student, and they carry execution_status and the counts so api never has to query the DB to do it. Two kinds travel on this queue: status=processing after each test case (driving execution.updated), and status=completed|error once (driving execution.completed). They share a queue so a completion can never overtake the progress messages that precede it.

status.description: Processing outcome. processing = one test case finished and more remain. completed = all test cases processed (pass or fail). error = infrastructure/system error (Judge0 down, DB write failed).

execution_status.description: Submission-level status, mirroring submissions.execution_status as CES has written it. `processing` accompanies status=processing; the rest are final.

latest_result.description: The test case that just finished. Present only when status=processing — it is what fills one cell of the verdict strip (ui-ux §4.2).

test_case_order.description: Position in the run, matching test_cases.order

testcases_passed.description: Number of test cases with status=accepted
